name: holtburg-walk-jump-collide
description: Wave 3.A physics replay probe scenario. Deterministic input sequence on the Holtburg landblock 0xA9B4 (per project_holtburger_academy_landblock memory: AC Training Academy is 0x8602; Holtburg town proper is 0xA9B4). The scenario exercises (a) the walking integrator over a slope, (b) a turn that should leave on-ground state unchanged, (c) a wall-push that should clamp the position delta against the building AABB index, and (d) a jump that leaves the ground and returns to on-ground via the ballistic-then-stick sequence.

phases.description: 60 idle ticks (~1 s) so the player lands cleanly on the ground after spawn and the initial server-pose authoritative reset has happened. We expect on_ground=true throughout this phase.

Hold W for 500 ticks (~8.3 s at 60 Hz). At the FALLBACK_RUN_RATE_SCALAR=4.5 m/s pace, that's ~37 m of forward travel across the Holtburg terrain. on_ground should remain true throughout (the terrain is gently sloping, not free-falling). This is the primary integrator-vs-oracle test.

Hold Q (turn left) for 60 ticks (~1 s) at NON_RUN_HELD_TURN_SPEED_RAD_PER_SEC=1.0 rad/s (no forward → run flag goes to false → walk-turn speed). Net rotation ≈ -1 rad ≈ -57°. on_ground should stay true; only heading changes.
Hold W for another 200 ticks (~3.3 s) on the new heading. Tests integrator stability after a heading change.
Idle for 60 ticks pre-jump. Lets velocity zero out so the jump test starts from a known rest state.

Press Space for the first 1 tick (jump is edge-triggered). Then 90 ticks (~1.5 s) of airborne ballistic motion. on_ground should be false for at least 30-60 of these ticks (ascending + descending) then true once the player lands. The wasm side currently does NOT have a full ballistic local-prediction integrator hooked into __predLastPos — the server-authoritative bounce-back is what we record. This is documented as a known incomplete capture path; the C# oracle simulates the full ballistic.
60 ticks for the player to settle back on the ground (if the jump completed mid-fall) and for any residual velocity to drain. Final state should be on_ground=true with zero velocity.
